status.rule: Build the custody-mechanics slice only. Core and Adapter are dependencies and must not be edited. Any need to change their public surface stops this work and requires a new Work Contract.

network.name: GenLayer Bradbury Phase 1
network.whyPhase1: The live PPA stack is deployed only on this chain. Current Phase 2 (rpc.testnet-chain.genlayer.com, genesis 0x17d89764d4f4f963158fc4c5e8f2cb670c2837740b35f37081c12860c3df97e4) has no PPA code. Phase 2 migration is explicitly out of scope.

testAsset.name: Nomos Test Asset
testAsset.minting: Owner-controlled fixture mint. The owner is the existing deployer account. No public faucet, no sale, no economic claim.

architecture.PPACustodyAuthorizer: GenLayer contract. Reads PPA Core get_consequence/get_payment/get_account, revalidates EXECUTED status and payment binding, maps the account currency to an allowlisted NTEST address, and calls the EVM vault authorize() as the only authorized caller. It has no balance authority and cannot alter Core state.
architecture.NomosCustodyVault: EVM contract. Holds NTEST, accepts intents only from the authorizer, stores the exact proposal-bound token/recipient/amount/expiry, rejects replay/expiry/pause/mismatch/insufficient-balance, records refusals, and exposes before/after balances.
architecture.NomosTestAsset: EVM ERC-20 used only as a custody-mechanics fixture. Owner-controlled mint. Separate deployment and fingerprint from the vault and authorizer.
architecture.settlementExecution: The vault settle() function is permissionless execution of an already-authorized immutable intent. It cannot change token, recipient, or amount. Authorization is the Core-bound gate; execution is deterministic. This separation is what allows negative-case transactions to be observed live without giving an EOA authorization authority.

custodyGates: authorize() caller must equal the configured PPACustodyAuthorizer EVM address
consequence/proposal ID must be present and unique
token must be allowlisted in the vault and mapped by the authorizer asset registry
recipient must equal the Core consequence requested_recipient and the settled payment to address
amount must equal the Core consequence requested_amount and the settled payment amount
Core consequence must be EXECUTED with reason_code EXECUTED
Core payment must be SETTLED and bound to the same proposal/payment/recipient/amount
Core account must be ACTIVE and its currency must map to the token
expiry must be in the future at authorize time and at settle time
custody token balance must cover the exact amount
custody token balance before/after and recipient balance before/after are recorded
every refusal leaves token balances unchanged
requiredNegativeCases: unauthorized caller (EOA calls vault authorize directly)

evidenceClassification.nftCustodyMechanics: TESTNET_OBSERVED only after independent cast/JSON-RPC readback

acceptanceGates: eth_estimateGas the exact NTEST, vault, and authorizer deploy encodings before any deployment; record each estimate
live Phase 1: token code readback and NTEST metadata readback
live Phase 1: vault and authorizer code readback
live Phase 1: authorized consequence settles exactly the requested NTEST amount
live Phase 1: all negative-case transactions and readbacks are recorded with no balance mutation
live Phase 1: independent readback of the exact settlement/refusal record
no private key printed or committed

gasPolicy.rule: Estimate before deploy. If an estimate does not fit the observed Bradbury ceiling, stop with DEPLOY_BLOCKED_GAS. Do not walk gas limits and do not strip annotations or safety gates.

sequence: deploy NomosCustodyVault with a temporary authorizer (deployer), NTEST allowlisted
deploy PPACustodyAuthorizer with Core, vault, NTEST, currency NTEST
mint NTEST fixture funds, approve and deposit into custody
create the PPA account and execute the bounded proposals
authorize and settle; run the negative cases

forbidden: Do not modify PPA Core or the Receipt/Proposal Adapter.
Do not put custody logic in PPA Core.
Do not trust a caller-supplied Core or PPA field as provenance.
Do not give the authorizer or the vault any Core balance authority.
Do not call NTEST USDC or imply official support, external backing, or real value.
Do not implement LayerZero/Hyperlane, a frontend, USDC, or Phase 2 migration.
Do not push to GitHub or alter main.
Do not print or commit private keys.
Do not claim production custody or bridge settlement.

notes: The custody slice is deliberately non-atomic: Core records the consequence and decrements its internal ledger before the EVM custody settlement. A custody refusal does not and must not roll back Core. The live evidence records that gap explicitly. The authorizer is a read-only consumer of Core consequences; it is not registered as a Core adapter.

gates.live_negative_cases: PASS for executed cases; insufficient-custody is Foundry-only

knownGaps: The authorizer record stays AUTHORIZED/execution=PENDING_FINALITY after finality; the vault record is authoritative.
Vault-side refusals (pause/token/expiry/duplicate) are not observable in the authorizer record in v0.1.
Insufficient-custody was covered by Foundry testTransferFailureRecordedNoConsumption, not executed live.
Finality delay is ~30-33 minutes on Bradbury Phase 1; TTL must cover the appeal window.
Amounts are token base units; no decimals scaling.
result.security: No private key is present in any artifact. A tracked key was exposed once in a shell transcript during development; rotation is recommended.
